title: Product Profile: Dairy
subtitle: 2021 Edition
org: Kenya Export Promotion and Branding Agency
intro: Kenya's dairy value chain spans milk and cream, milk powders, butter and cheese, supplied by smallholder herders and commercial dairy processors across the country. With a growing formal dairy industry and recognised market access in regional and international destination markets, dairy is a significant contributor to Kenya's agricultural exports.

This profile examines Kenya's trade in dairy produce (HS Chapter 04: milk and cream; yogurt, buttermilk and other fermented or acidified milk and cream; whey and natural milk constituents; butter and other fats and oils derived from milk; and cheese and curd), based on trade values reported to the International Trade Centre (ITC) for 2021.

The family draws together fresh and concentrated milk and cream, milk powders, butter and cheese. Presenting them as a single portfolio provides a clear picture of the size, product mix and market orientation of Kenya's dairy exports.
